label: captured
validation_scope: Validated on trace-commons (28 sessions, full transcript-to-git join, blame agreement ~100%) and local repositories; at-scale validation on SWE-chat (SALT-NLP, 17,968 sessions) completed Oct 2026 with a partial pass: bimodality reproduced approximately (agent-all mode 40.9% vs published 41%), pushback reproduced on the dominant agent (49.2% vs ~50% for Claude Code excluding first turns; pooled 39.6-40.7% and agent-mix-sensitive), survival not reproduced (metric-v2 aggregate 53.4% vs published 59%; per-agent survival 25-97%, so survival stays a context field, stratified by agent where known). post_first_prompt_share is validated as a steering-presence detector (SWE-chat medians: 0.0 one-prompt, 0.75 continued no-pushback, 0.97 pushback sessions), not a steering-dose measure; at SWE-chat scale it was computed as the gross-added-lines analogue of this field's final-lines definition (see swe-chat/VALIDATION.md section 6). Document mode ground-truth-tested on CoAuthor (1,447 human-GPT-3 writing sessions, CHI 2022): per-part 'unchanged from first version' labels validated (sentence-level agreement 88.3%, false-untouched rate ~0.05%); the doc headline % unchanged is a floor on the untouched share, not a dose estimate (mean absolute error 13.0 pp against keystroke truth, sensitive to revision granularity). Document receipts contain no rejection evidence: material rejected or dismissed before it ever entered a revision is invisible to doc mode, so doc-mode steering evidence is a lower bound on interaction (see coauthor/VALIDATION-coauthor.md). Impact classification (v1.4, from the Oct 2026 impact spike): segments are also classified by measured effect on the artifact (procedural, continuation, reshaping, unmeasured) from line provenance alone. Reshaping share separated steered sessions from near-one-prompt controls at AUC 0.929, against 0.602 for the keyword correction segment share and 0.616 for the keyword line share; every control session measured exactly 0 reshaping segments. In interactive Claude Code sessions 52.8% of human turns are procedural (no file effect), so raw turn counts overstate steering roughly twofold. Scope caveat: reshaping detects inter-segment rework, and reads as human steering only when the segments are genuine human turns; in the headless Codex batch the follow-up prompts were a pre-written escalation ladder fired on schedule, and reshaping there (median share 66.7%) measures the scripted schedule and agent self-repair, not a human steering.

mark.basis: 7 human turns; 3 of them reshaped earlier work (42.9% of turns, 9 earlier lines rewritten)

git_join.method: reconstructed local git repo, one commit per human-turn segment (plus a pre-existing commit when --repo seeding occurred); git blame on HEAD cross-checked vs in-memory line provenance
git_join.git_ai_style_line_authorship: agent-typed vs pre-existing split is reported via per_segment origin -1; authorship alone carries no triage signal (spike finding)

impact.method: effect-based segment classification from line provenance (impact spike, Oct 2026): a segment is reshaping when an applied op edited or deleted lines an earlier segment introduced; prompt text is never read
impact.scope: Impact classes measure inter-segment rework. The segments of this receipt are the human's own typed inputs in an interactive Claude Code session, so reshaping reads as human steering: a later input changed what an earlier input produced.

decisions.method: AskUserQuestion tool calls paired with their tool results and each answered question classified by its chosen answer (decision-points spike, Oct 2026): followed_recommendation when the answer equals the option marked (Recommended), diverged_to_listed when it equals a different listed option (on unmarked questions, any listed pick), free_text_answers when it matches no listed label; question text is never stored, counts and categories only
decisions.scope: Decision fields count the structured questions the agent asked and the user answered. Followed and diverged are defined only where the agent marked a recommended option, and decisions_with_recommendation is their denominator: agents mark inconsistently (4% of questions in one validated corpus, 40% in another). A listed pick on an unmarked question counts as diverged_to_listed and means only that the user chose among the offered options. Free-text answers mean the user left the offered options entirely. Sessions where the agent never asks have zero decision points, which says nothing about steering through ordinary turns.

labels.semantic_weights: none — rule-based categories only; no model calls
labels.receipt_nature: descriptive evidence, not a certified grade
labels.mark_semantics: the mark names the process shape (how the work was steered), never its quality; it is not a grade
labels.field_status: headline_fields validated in spike; context_fields demoted (survival saturates on greenfield corpora); supporting_fields noisy, read jointly with turn count

capture.method: segments are marked captured when a steering record under refs/notes/steer claims them: the record is anchored to the commit that carries it and its recorded segment hash equals the hash of this transcript's segment bytes. Captured segments are additionally checked against their commit's diff. Every other segment keeps the standing post-hoc classification and is counted inferred, or unmeasured when the replay could not measure its effect.
capture.scope: Capture fields separate segments whose steering was recorded at commit time in git notes (refs/notes/steer) from segments classified after the fact by replay. A segment counts as captured only when a record claims it, the record is anchored to the commit that carries it, and the recorded segment hash equals the hash of this transcript's segment bytes. Verified against the transcript means the segment hashes were recomputed from the held transcript and the recorded hunks were checked against the commit diffs. Verified against the commit means only the diff checks ran, which prove the recorded hunks are really in the commit, not that the recorded classes are right. Absence of records reads as zero captured, never as absence of steering.
